mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies and a temperature of 58 degrees while you are out enjoying the Military Ridge State Trail.

City updates include important pavement repairs happening this Tuesday and Wednesday near Nine Mound Road and Morningside Boulevard, so please keep an eye out for parking notices. Additionally, the Plan Commission is preparing to review several development projects, including plans for Sub-Zero at Liberty Business Park, at their upcoming December 7 meeting.

We have a packed schedule with live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard today, followed by yoga at Insight Wellness tomorrow. Looking ahead to Tuesday, you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, or Paddy Mac's, plus live music and pizza specials.

In our weekly report, officers handled a variety of calls including an incident on October 25 where a driver was arrested for an O W I after being located stationary at an intersection for an extended period.
Today at Culver's, you can grab a scoop of the delightful Snickers Swirl. The shop is currently open, so feel free to stop by anytime until they close at 10:00 PM tonight.
